name: Store Ops Desk
description: Every store in the chain, scored the same way and kept current by agents from standards audits, the POS, review sites, the scheduling system and the facilities queue, with the actions that fix the ones that slip.

label.en: Which stores are slipping, and how much revenue is at risk?
label.zh-CN: 哪些门店在下滑，多少营收有风险

body.en: Read the `busa-store-ops` skill in this folder and follow it. Answer as the head of store operations: revenue at risk and how many stores are on standard, then every at-risk store, lowest score first, with its revenue, the measure that hurt most, and the open action. Then every store whose standards audit is overdue. Keep it to one screen. Do not change anything.
body.zh-CN: 先阅读本文件夹里的 `busa-store-ops` Skill，按它的规则做。以门店运营负责人的口吻回答：先说多少营收有风险、多少门店达标，再按评分从低到高列出每家有风险的门店，附营收、拉低最多的指标和对应的整改措施；然后列出巡店逾期的门店。控制在一屏以内。不要修改任何记录。

body.en: Read the `busa-store-ops` skill in this folder and follow it. For each store, read the audit score, sales, reviews, staffing and overdue fixes from their sources, write a signal for anything that moved, re-score it by the skill’s rule, propose an action for any store newly at risk, and then write this week’s store review as a draft.
body.zh-CN: 先阅读本文件夹里的 `busa-store-ops` Skill，按它的规则做。为每家门店从数据来源读取巡店得分、销售、点评、排班和逾期整改，有变动的写一条信号，按 Skill 的规则重新打分，新变成有风险的提一条整改措施，最后写一份本周门店周报草稿。

body.en: Read the `busa-store-ops` skill in this folder and follow it. Write the store review for last Monday to Sunday: a one-line headline, revenue at risk, how many stores are on standard, every at-risk store with what is wrong and the action, every store whose audit is overdue, and what changed since last week.
body.zh-CN: 先阅读本文件夹里的 `busa-store-ops` Skill，按它的规则做。写上周一到周日的门店周报：一句话结论、有风险的营收、达标门店数、每家有风险门店的问题和对应措施、巡店逾期的门店、与上周相比的变化。

body.en: Read the `busa-store-ops` skill in this folder and follow it. List the stores an area manager should visit this week, most urgent first: every at-risk store and every store with no audit in the last 30 days, grouped by region, with what to check at each. Do not change anything.
body.zh-CN: 先阅读本文件夹里的 `busa-store-ops` Skill，按它的规则做。列出本周区域经理该去的门店，最急的排前面：每家有风险的门店，以及近 30 天没巡过的门店，按区域分组，写清每家要查什么。不要修改任何记录。
